action.name: Comment when the chain ends here

description: Fires on a PR comment by an author in vars.trusted_authors (never the App itself); a comment whose PR facts could not be read (pr_enriched false) never fires. Same-repo, non-draft PRs of repos in vars.fixer_repos only; vars.fixer_excluded_repos overrides it. Starts a pr-fix chain; shares the pr-fix workflow and the per-PR concurrency key and attempt budget with the other pr-fixer-* rules. The body must start with a command or mention the App in vars.fixer_comment_triggers (default /fix and @rules-culture-dev). Only while the PR is open.
name: PR fixer: trusted PR comment

on_failure.name: Hand back with the run link (once per chain)

params.body:
PR fixer handed back ({{ run.error.code }}): {{ run.error.message }}

Run: https://rules.culture.dev/api/runs/{{ run.id }}

inputs.instruction: {{ trigger.data.author }} (a trusted author) commented on PR {{ trigger.data.repository }}#{{ trigger.data.number }}: {{ trigger.data.comment }} Work on the PR head branch {{ trigger.data.head_branch }} only. Fix the failing checks and the SonarCloud issues behind the failing quality gate, and address the review threads in the threads input (and no other thread). Never edit .github/workflows, never delete or skip tests and never add suppression markers. In threads_addressed, use each thread's thread_id exactly as the threads input gives it. For SonarCloud, the sonar_issues input lists only the issues behind the failing quality-gate conditions and sonar_note says what the gate needs: fix exactly those, never the rest of the Sonar backlog.
